description: What a new game begins with. The Naming hands over a named character; this says where the story opens, on what quest and after which cinematic, so a content pack can open somewhere else entirely without touching code. The Foundling wakes at the top of the Hushline Stair, in the ash, and is walked out of it. The cinematic plays first and the quest starts when control is handed back (DESIGN 5.1a).
